panel.title: Vireek Assistant
panel.notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a human. Answers come from Vireek's published pages.
panel.dashboardNotice: This assistant answers product questions only. It cannot see your account data.

welcome.greeting: Hi, I'm the Vireek assistant. Ask me about plans, features, integrations, security or how to get set up.
welcome.greetingDashboard: Hi! Ask me how something in Vireek works. For your own numbers, use the account assistant.

composer.label: Message to Vireek assistant
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line

handoff.title: Want a person to take over?
handoff.body: Your conversation comes with you, so you won't need to repeat yourself.
handoff.liveOffline: Leave a message for our team (we reply within 24 hours)
handoff.lowConfidence: I'm not sure about this one. I don't want to guess, so here are the quickest ways to get a definite answer.

states.offline: You appear to be offline. Your question will not send until you reconnect.
states.rateLimited: You've reached the question limit for now. Try again in a little while, or talk to our team.
